findings.title: [P1] Preserve tenant isolation when authorizing document reads
findings.body: Returning `true` unconditionally allows users to read documents belonging to any tenant. Calls with differing `userTenant` and `documentTenant` values now pass authorization, creating a cross-tenant data exposure vulnerability.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant ownership check
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/access.ts:2 still returns true unconditionally. The full base-to-head diff shows this PR replaced `return userTenant === documentTenant;` with `return true;`, so cross-tenant reads remain allowed.
